_doc: Signals that fire on no language-crucible file, each with the reason (#4108). tests/tools/signal_coverage.py check fails when a signal not listed here drops to zero, or a listed one starts firing. A zero here is a blind spot of the golden master: a regression in that signal cannot show up in the golden diff.

zero_coverage.Invisible Unicode Payload Smuggling: no real public file carries a variation-selector/tag-character payload; the crucible's Unicode examples are negative controls (#4135) and do not trigger. Needs a planted case in keyword-rosetta, not real code. Interim guard: tests/core_engine/test_zero_coverage_signals_4108.py scans planted files end to end
